_comment: Gate A15: every Hue light type (the v1 `type`) diyHue's bridge emulator gives a model is either one hueemu answers with (the catalog, by light type — hueemu answers per light type, not per model) or excluded with its reason. diyHue is the open reference implementation of the Hue bridge API; a new type there is the moment to check whether a client needs another light type.

excluded.On/Off plug-in unit: Sealed core decision K2 (accepted 2026-11-11 07:37): a pure on/off light presents itself as a dimmable light — the Harmony Hub does not know an on/off type and shows full colour controls for it (v1.0.13, b74eb43); hueemu answers every on/off light as Dimmable light LWB007.
